areas.label: Production
areas.description: Creating and executing media productions, including production management and craft workflows; distinct from editorial commissioning and ongoing service operations.

areas.label: Media operations
areas.description: Running recurring media services, including asset handling, scheduling, operational workflows, service delivery and operational reliability.

areas.label: Content & editorial
areas.description: Commissioning, acquiring, programming, curating and making editorial decisions about content; distinct from executing production.

areas.label: Distribution & delivery
areas.description: Getting media to audiences through distribution platforms, channels, delivery systems and associated partnerships.

areas.label: Engineering & technology
areas.description: Designing, integrating, developing and maintaining media technology, systems and infrastructure.

areas.label: Commercial
areas.description: Revenue, sales, business development, advertising business, commercial partnerships and commercial rights activity.

areas.label: Strategy & leadership
areas.description: Organisational direction, executive decision-making, investment priorities and business strategy; not a measure of seniority or invitation eligibility.

topics.label: Monetisation
topics.description: How media creates revenue and economic value, including subscriptions, transactions, pricing and revenue models; advertising is one mechanism, not a synonym.

topics.label: Content discovery
topics.description: How people find and choose content through search, recommendations, navigation, metadata and prominence; distinct from continuing engagement.

topics.label: AI & automation
topics.description: AI applications and automated processes in media; workflow or organisational change does not automatically imply AI.

topics.label: Workflow transformation
topics.description: Changes to how work moves between people, tools and stages, focusing on processes and implementation rather than organisational structure or culture.

topics.label: Streaming
topics.description: Internet-delivered media services and their operation, product experience and delivery.

topics.label: Cloud & infrastructure
topics.description: Compute, storage, networking, hosting and infrastructure architecture supporting media, including on-premises and hybrid infrastructure.

topics.label: Security
topics.description: Protecting systems, content, services and information against threats, including access controls and resilience to attacks; not automatically privacy or regulatory compliance.

topics.label: Audience engagement
topics.description: Participation, retention, loyalty and audience relationships; distinct from finding content.

topics.label: Advertising
topics.description: Advertising products, inventory, buying and selling, targeting, delivery and effectiveness; distinct from broader revenue strategy.

topics.label: Rights & licensing
topics.description: Ownership, permissions, exploitation rights, licensing agreements and rights management; not a general legal or compliance category.

topics.label: Data & measurement
topics.description: Collecting, managing, analysing and measuring media, business and audience data; apply only where data or measurement is a substantive subject.

topics.label: Organisational change
topics.description: Changes to organisational structure, roles, skills, culture and operating models; distinct from changing an individual workflow.

topics.label: Industry strategy
topics.description: Media-industry direction, competitive positioning, business-model choices, investment and market structure; distinct from revenue mechanics.
